name: Saotome Ryuuji
source: As the head butler serving under Kana Takamine, he's tasked with guarding her and taking care of her every need. He's the ultimate butler, able to change unto a spotless butler uniform in a moment's notice and carry out his master's every order. His inhumane strength, agility, and perception allow him to protect Kana from any and all danger.
